# Document templates

Structure definitions and worked examples for the help document types described in [technical-doc-overview.md][].
Each structure file lists the required section order, heading levels, and formatting rules, then supplies an English template and a Japanese template to copy from.

Use these templates together with the style guides in the parent folder, which [docs/README.md][] indexes.


## Contents

* [how-to-guides-template-structure.md][] - Section order and formatting rules for how-to guides.
  A table pairs each English section name with its Japanese counterpart, gives the heading level, marks the section required or optional, and adds guidance on what belongs in it.
* [how-to-guides-example.md][] - A complete sample how-to guide, "Easily bulk edit files in Visual Studio Code", that shows the how-to structure filled in.
* [reference-document-template-structure.md][] - Section order and formatting rules for reference documents, which are information-oriented technical descriptions of the software and how to operate it.
